_bob.purpose: Prompt to one seamless albedo. Bob derives the rest of the set in numpy.
_bob.derived_from: ComfyUI-seamless-tiling/tiled_workflow.png (pack SHA 9225ed5), converted to API format by tools/scripts/comfy_ui_to_api.py
deviations_from_source: OffsetImage and both PreviewImage nodes dropped; a SaveImage titled BOB_OUT added, because Bob fetches the result over /view rather than looking at it.
ckpt_name repointed from albedobaseXL_v21 to the D1 checkpoint.
sampler tuned for the D1 checkpoint: 25 steps, cfg 5.0, dpmpp_2m + karras (the source had 20 / 4.5 / normal).
a real negative prompt, because the source left it empty and baked lighting is W1's main failure mode.
BOB_* titles added on the six templated nodes.
_bob.notes: Both halves of the padding switch are needed, measured: circular UNet with a stock zero-padded VAE decode leaves a seam 2.7x the interior difference. The source graph used CircularVAEDecode for the VAE half; this uses MakeCircularVAE plus the stock VAEDecode instead, because CircularVAEDecode deepcopies the live VAE per execution and discards it, and the server segfaults inside load_models_gpu on the next decode of the session. MakeCircularVAE's copy is retained in the execution cache and survives repeated runs.

inputs.text: shadow, cast shadow, vignette, lighting gradient, specular highlight, glare, blur, depth of field, perspective, horizon, sky, plant closeup, object, text, watermark, signature, border, frame, seam
